steps: IM ADRENALINE 0.5 mg (0.5 mL 1:1000) into anterolateral thigh - repeat every 5 min as needed. FIRST and most important step.
Remove trigger; lie flat with legs raised (sit up if breathing difficulty); high-flow oxygen.
IV fluid bolus for hypotension; nebulised salbutamol for bronchospasm.
Refractory: IV adrenaline infusion in a monitored setting.
Observe 6-12 h (biphasic risk); prescribe adrenaline auto-injector + allergy referral.

confirm: Acute onset of airway/breathing/circulation compromise ± urticaria/angioedema after an allergen exposure.
